notes: Held at Douglass Community Center and the Loudoun County Government Center, both in Leesburg. In 2026 there were 8 spots for each voting district, with a waitlist.
name: Loudoun Youth in Government Day
org: Loudoun County Board of Supervisors and county staff
what_you_do: One day with county leaders. You have lunch with the Board of Supervisors, join a panel and tour a community center. You also sit on the dais during a Board meeting.
who_can_apply: Loudoun County high school juniors and seniors.
deadline_text: The 2026 day was Tuesday, Oct 20, 2026, and applications closed Sept 25, 2026. The county took the program page down, and the 2027 date is not posted.
how_to_apply: In 2026 the form opened Sept 1 and closed Sept 25. Check loudoun.gov/Teens or email the county Teen Services team.
